character: A halfling man in his forties, short and stocky with the sturdy build and proportions of his people, standing about four feet tall, neat and carefully groomed with tidy brown curls. His expression is composed and professionally pleasant, a merchant's practised courteous smile held firmly in place: he is a man managing his own face. The worry shows only at the edges, in the tightness around his eyes and the dark circles under them, and in the way his hands are held a little too still. Calm, controlled, mask firmly on
wardrobe: dressed considerably above his station in the Emarrean court fashion he saw exactly once: a long deep wine-red coat of figured silk brocade with a subtle woven pattern, gold-thread edging at the cuffs and collar, polished brass buttons, over an embroidered waistcoat in deep rose silk and a soft cream cravat pinned with a small gold pin. Every piece immaculate and a little too fine and a little too much together, the outfit of a provincial cloth merchant imitating a court he briefly sold to

full.framing: Full body standing portrait of a short stocky halfling, three-quarter view, hands clasped neatly in front of him, composed and courteous.

portrait.framing: Head and shoulders portrait, square crop, composed polite expression, a practised courteous smile that does not reach the eyes, head and upper chest filling the frame.

scene.framing: A short halfling merchant standing behind a cloth merchant's counter stacked with bolts of fabric, a length of deep rose silk framed on the wall behind him, composed and courteous, one hand resting near the silk square in his pocket.
